name: Hotel Gasthof Stangl
beschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Stangl in Thaur is nestled at the base of the Karwendel Mountains, only a few kilometres from Innsbruck. Operated as a dedicated family business, it uniquely blends a traditional Tyrolean inn with an active farm. Guests enjoy immediate access to marked hiking and biking trails as well as the Nordkette and Glungezer ski areas. Highlights include a restaurant serving produce from the property's own farm, a beer garden, and a relaxing wellness sauna area.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Stangl in Thaur near Innsbruck combines farm-to-table dining, family hospitality, an on-site sauna wellness area, and immediate access to Karwendel trails.
